audit_metadata.verdict: NON-RAG AI/ML COMPLETE — PRD COMPLIANT (WITH DOCUMENTED CHUNK-LEVEL GAP)

ndcg_discrepancy_investigation.exact_cause_of_discrepancy: The earlier report used canonical email-level retrieval (retriever.retrieve(query, top_k=5)), which evaluates 5 full deduplicated email candidates against expected_email_ids, achieving nDCG@5 = 0.8701. The latest report used raw chunk retrieval (retrieve_results(top_k=5)) and filtered out None values produced by Level-1 Thread Summary cards. Because exactly one Thread Summary was retrieved in top-5 for all 15 queries, filtering out None resulted in an evaluated list of only 4 emails instead of 5. This artificially truncated the 5th email candidate for Q001, Q003, Q007, and Q010, lowering Macro Recall from 1.0000 to 0.9000 and Macro nDCG@5 from 0.8701 to 0.8183, while MRR remained at 0.8556 because shifting rank 2 up to rank 1 preserved reciprocal rank. Furthermore, the latest report had an audit classification error by labeling 0.8183 as HIGH instead of FAIL against PRD target >= 0.85.

canonical_email_retrieval.description: Evaluates top-5 distinct emails mapped from bodies, attachments, and tables via retriever.retrieve(query, top_k=5)

chunk_level_retrieval_filtered.description: Evaluates top-5 chunks via retrieve_results(top_k=5) with None stripped (yielding 4 emails)

chunk_level_retrieval_raw.description: Evaluates top-5 chunks directly where Thread Summary at rank 1 is scored as rel=0
